sentences.text: Code vs In Re : Saukat Ali on 8 April, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
08.04.2025 Item No.20 Ct.No.34 rc.
C.R.M. (Db) 2928 of 2024 In Re : An Application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure read with Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection
with Chanchal Police Station Case No. 864 of 2023 dated 14.07.2023 under Sections 498A/302/34
of the Indian Penal Code.
 And
 In Re : Saukat Ali
 ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Ayan Basu
 Mr. Topodip Gupta
 Mr. Sumit Routh ... for the Petitioner.
 Ms. Faria Hossain
 Ms. Sujata Das ... For the State.
Report submitted by the State is taken on record.
The petitioner seeks confirmation of the interim bail granted in his favour vide an order dated January 28, 2025.
No adverse report being found against the petitioner, the interim bail is confirmed.
However, the conditions of bail imposed upon the petitioner shall continue.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
